I'm returning no picks. This isn't a finding that nothing is open in Ottawa. I searched Ottawa for museums, children's museums, farms and zoos, but nothing I read met the bar for a pick on Aug 30 to Sept 2. Here is what I found and why each one was left out.

- **Canadian Children's Museum (Canadian Museum of History):** This is a real, on-topic find on the museum's own page. The page posts hours of 
Sept. 8 to Dec. 9, 2026
, which starts after the visit ends. It carries no hours for Aug 30 to Sept 2, so I can't give a `when` for those days. It also gives no age range for the children's area.
- **Canada Science and Technology Museum:** The hours I found (open daily 9 to 5 in summer, closed Mondays from September) come from directory and review sites, not the museum's own page. Under the rules, those aren't a source I can cite.
- **Valleyview Little Animal Farm:** Its own page lists 
May 1 – October 31, 2026, Tuesday thru Sunday, open holiday Mondays, 9:30am – 4:00pm
. It also says 
train rides will be suspended starting September 8, 2026
. The page gives no age range, so I can't fill in `age_fit` from the source. It is the strongest lead to confirm.
- **The Log Farm:** Its page lists a fall season from Sept. 3, which is after the window. It gives no hours for the visit days.
- **Dates:** Today is Oct 15, 2026, so Aug 30 to Sept 2 means 2027. Operators haven't posted 2027 hours yet, only the 2026 season.

If this is re-run closer to the visit, the first things to check are the museum's summer hours and Valleyview's 2027 season dates.
